# MS Tech EBook

MS Tech EBook is an online digital bookstore where readers can discover ebook titles, review book details, and purchase available digital editions. The website provides a public storefront and a personal library for signed-in readers.

## Main resources
- [Home](https://mstech-ebook.store/): Browse the ebook storefront and featured titles.
- [Sitemap](https://mstech-ebook.store/sitemap.xml): Discover public URLs published for search engines.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mstech-ebook.store/privacy-policy): Read the website privacy policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://mstech-ebook.store/terms-of-service): Read the website terms of service.

## Notes
- Book availability, prices, and descriptions can change; use the live storefront for current information.
- Account, library, administrative, and payment functions may require authentication. Do not assume private account data is publicly accessible.
- Use only public pages and documented public interfaces. Do not attempt to bypass access controls.
